title: Element
description: Plite element node types and pure helpers.
---

Elements contain descendant nodes and represent block or inline structure.
Schema policy such as block, inline, void, and selectable behavior belongs to
`editor.read.schema`.

See the canonical [Element reference](/docs/plite/api/nodes/element).
